about: Tell us what capture actually does in your browser
title: "[Browser] "

---

Reports that capture does **not** work somewhere are as valuable as reports that it
does. The support table has to reflect reality, and a wrong table costs someone a
recording.

## Environment

Browser and version, operating system and version.

## What you tried

- [ ] Screen capture
- [ ] Window capture
- [ ] Tab capture
- [ ] Camera
- [ ] Microphone
- [ ] Tab or system audio

## What happened

For each item above: worked, worked with a caveat, or failed — and how it failed.

## Playback

Did the resulting recording play? Did seeking work, forwards and backwards?
